message:
Manager, Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer, Solar Energy Systems Engineer and Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist, the chamber feet must carry only chamber weight on a separated path.

In plain words lumping the distant ground frame onto the box feet overstated the box pressure, so I recomputed with separate paths. Chamber superstructure without foundations is 1930 kg in the chamber-only mass sum (E126), reusing produce plus crates plus racking plus panels plus door plus battery plus eutectic plus monoblock plus roof gantry shares from the complete superstructure mass sum (E118) but excluding the seven-module ground frame, and with six 400 mm by 400 mm pads plus their own self-weight it gives 23.2 kPa in the chamber-only pad pressure (E127), still below 150 kPa soil from the Structural Design Calculation Sheet | PDF | Strength Of Materials | Precast Concrete (E62), about one person standing so everyday scale holds, which supersedes 19.8 kPa from the chamber structure soil pressure (E119) as the chamber-only controlling value while the ground frame goes to its own footings.

Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer and Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist, your 900 mm door and eight-opening rule sets my opening frame and seal detail.

In plain words a one-crate door with a curtain is a small hole that must still close tight. The Coolroom Buying Guide: Walk-In Refrigeration for Kitchens (E71) states standard coolroom doors are 900 mm wide, which I confirm from my discipline because it passes one 600 mm by 400 mm crate at a time from the crates for 1 tonne check (E77) while keeping the framed opening small, and it carries the single door model 8 curtain openings sensible plus latent (E110) at 0.169 kWh per day only if I provide gasket plus flashing at the rear penetration and a trapped drain plus clamped soft curtain to rigid Polyisocyanurate (PIR, rigid foam insulation) seal already tied to the dimensioned crate layout sketch (E124).

My position is ready on version two, because separated chamber pressure, quantified uplift hold and crate layout now close except field pull test and 43 degree pull-down bench test needing built hardware.
